workflow: Repair Go sources only under /app/featurectl and /app/cargograph
From /app run make build then make run
critical_behaviors: Go 1.24 toolchain is preinstalled at /usr/local/go/bin on PATH; do not apt install
make build must leave compiled binary at /app/build/featrecon only
Load scenario captures from /app/crate-captures/{scenario_id}.json; never use /app/work-captures for digests
runtime_feature_set entries are bare crate_key strings sorted ascending, never crate_key/feature compounds
dev profile runtime_feature_set includes target passing crates even when active_features is empty
release profile runtime_feature_set omits crates whose active features are entirely dev_only
Purge stale feature conflict rows when unification replaces the winning version and resolved crate_key changes
Do not purge conflict rows when the same coordinate keeps the same resolved version and only active_features merge
Workspace members listed in declared use source workspace_declared even when workspace_pins override version
Declared optional crates still traverse their dependency subtrees
Weak optional edges are skipped unless the child crate is also declared
Expand feature_aliases into concrete feature names before merging workspace or edge features; never keep alias keys in active_features
Sort sibling edges by child name ascending then edge_id ascending before walking
Process declared roots in manifest declared array order not alphabetical crate name order
At equal depth use resolution_reason unified when incumbent parent_key wins lexicographic tie-break; nearest when contender parent_key wins
Root digest and payload length fields follow digest_encoding.json exactly
